name.local: 親子天下 教育新創20+

aka: 親子天下教育創新中心加速計畫

strategy.thesis: Taiwan's first accelerator purpose-built for education startups, run by CommonWealth Parenting media with National Development Council backing and NTU Entrepreneurship Center mentoring; selects ~20 high-growth EdTech teams per cohort and matches them with VC and corporate resources.

perks: 7 months of business strategy, market guidance and 1:1 mentor coaching via NTU Entrepreneurship Center
6 teams taken to EduTECH Asia in Singapore for exhibition and business matching

notable_investments.company: 必揚實境科技 Biyang VR Academy

application.how_to_apply: Open recruitment cycle (~1 month) announced via CommonWealth Parenting; selection by panel.

summary.en: Accelerator launched in 2020 by CommonWealth Parenting (親子天下) — one of the only Taiwan accelerators built specifically for education startups. Funded with National Development Council resources and delivered with NTU Entrepreneurship Center; first cohort selected 20 EdTech teams from ~100 applicants spanning online learning, board games, robotics, coding, AR/VR, camps and social-enterprise preschool.
summary.local: 親子天下於2020年推出的教育新創專屬加速計畫，是台灣少數針對「教育」量身打造的加速器。獲國家發展委員會資源挹注、與台大創創中心合作，第一屆從近百件報名中選出20家教育新創，涵蓋線上學習、桌遊、機器人、程式設計、AR/VR、營隊與社企幼兒等類別。

name.local: 工研院創新工業技術移轉公司 數位經濟基金

strategy.thesis: Investment arm of Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute; its Digital Economy Fund (co-leveraging ITRI and Institute for Information Industry expertise) targets AI, data, blockchain and IoT — and led the EdTech round of language-learning platform VoiceTube.

summary.en: ITIC (established 1979) is the investment arm of ITRI and has invested over NT$12 billion in startups. Its Digital Economy Fund — backed jointly by ITRI and the Institute for Information Industry (資策會) — invested in VoiceTube's Series A, making it one of the most institutional EdTech backers in Taiwan.
summary.local: 工研院創新工業技術移轉公司（ITIC，成立於1979年）為工研院投資部門，累計投資新創逾新台幣120億元。旗下「數位經濟基金」由工研院與資策會共同挹注研發能量，曾投資VoiceTube的A輪，是台灣最具機構規模的EdTech投資者之一。

strategy.thesis: Taiwan's largest private angel community; invests small-ticket angel-to-Series-A cheques across fintech, logistics, healthcare, education, entertainment and sustainability, emphasizing founder mentorship over pure financial return. Education is an explicit sector.

summary.en: Founded in 2017, Smart Capital (識富天使會) is Taiwan's largest private angel investment community. Over seven years it has invested in 54 startups with a 94% survival rate, ~70% expanding overseas, across sectors that explicitly include education. Invitation-only membership of enterprise founders, business successors and professionals.

name.local: 三貝德數位文創股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Taiwan-listed (TPEx: 8489) digital-education group that grows by acquiring and taking strategic stakes in education businesses, consolidating digital learning platforms with physical education services.

notable_investments.company: 亞洲教育平台 Asia Education Platform
弋果文化 Lingo Culture (英語教育)

summary.en: Founded 2006 and listed on Taipei Exchange (8489) in 2017, Samebest (三貝德) is a digital-education group whose product suite includes 升學王/小學王/萌學園 etc. It acts as a strategic investor/acquirer in EdTech: in 2025 its board approved a ~NT$427M tender for up to 100% of Asia Education Platform and a ~NT$815M purchase of 48.32% of English-education firm Lingo Culture (弋果文化).
summary.local: 三貝德成立於2006年、2017年於櫃買中心掛牌（8489），是數位教育集團，產品含升學王、小學王、萌學園等。在EdTech領域扮演策略投資/併購者：2025年董事會通過以約4.27億元公開收購亞洲教育平台至多100%股權，並以約8.15億元取得英語教育業者弋果文化48.32%股份。
